title: Product (us-ga-hemp profile)
description: Narrows core Product for Georgia consumable-hemp retail (profile.json, effective_date 2024-10-01). allOf-only composition over core — profiles restrict, never extend (decision-hemp-interchange-schema-scope). Cross-field/computed rules (total-THC math, per-form mg caps, COA 12-month recency) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and live in rules/index.mjs, keyed by the same rule IDs documented in rules/README.md.

product_form.description: GA-FORM-BAN — flower and preroll are excluded from GA retail (SB 494 §1; see rules/README.md#ga-form-ban). 'beverage' is permitted and capped by GA-CAP-beverage (40-32-5-.06 P2; see rules/README.md).

regulatory_class.description: GA-REG-CLASS — GA consumable-hemp retail (GDA-regulated) covers hemp-derived and delta-8 products. marijuana and other_cannabis are excluded: they sit under a different licensing regime entirely, not this retail channel. This mapping is Relay's interpretation of 'GA hemp retail' scope, not a value taken verbatim from a numbered claim in research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449 — flagged in the Phase 4 report.

items.description: GA-COA-GATE (structural half) — a GA package must carry a linked LabResult meeting the profile's COA requirements. The 12-month recency check is date-relative and lives in rules/index.mjs#checkCoaGate, not here (decision-coa-publication-gate).
